title: Q2 Alignment: Endpoint Lineup Prioritization, Experiment Lanes, and OKR Mapping
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: create a decision framework and working backlog for Q2 that aligns hosted endpoint lineup choices with OKRs, cost and latency guardrails, and a set of experiment lanes for model variants. Scope: prioritize which endpoints are promoted to 'stable' for Q2, which model variants receive canary ramps, deprecation candidates, and the set of evaluation prompt-sets we will lock for regression monitoring. Out of scope: infra-level scheduling/placement decisions (handled by ENG runtime roadmap) and detailed infra capacity reservations for Dedicated customers. Outcomes: 1) a prioritized endpoint list with owners and commit windows, 2) experiment lanes with success criteria and rollback rules, 3) mapped OKRs (team-level and company-level) tied to the roadmap, 4) a minimal set of regression prompts and metrics for each endpoint to guard quality during rotations.
acceptance_criteria: Prioritized endpoint list published and reviewed by Eng/Design/Support
Experiment lanes documented with success/failure thresholds and canary cadence
OKR mapping completed: each prioritized endpoint references at least one measurable OKR
Regression prompt-sets (min 50 prompts per high-impact endpoint) uploaded to evals bucket and ownership assigned
Delivery plan includes clear rollback policies and cost guardrails per endpoint
tasks: Workshop: cross-functional prioritization session (PM/Eng/Design/Support) - owner: Miguel
Draft endpoint scoring rubric (latency sensitivity, revenue exposure, developer demand, cost delta) - owner: Aisha
Define experiment lanes and canary windows (percent traffic, duration) - owner: Eng Reliability lead
Assemble regression prompt-sets and target metrics for each endpoint - owner: Applied ML
Publish roadmap tranche spreadsheet and sync with Console release calendar - owner: PM ops
Schedule stakeholder review with Sales and Security for enterprise-impacting endpoints - owner: Miguel
Create GH repo with evaluation harness and reference PR template - owner: Eng SDK
decisions: Adopt a blended scoring rubric that weights customer exposure and latency sensitivity higher than novelty score
Use 3 experiment lanes: stability, quality-led improvement, and cost-optimization. Each lane has separate success metrics
Canary cadence default: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 72 hours unless endpoint is HIGH-risk, then require manual sign-off
Model retirement requires 30-day deprecation window plus a fallback variant declared in the endpoint config
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: downstream customers may see regressions during model swaps - Mitigation: require regression prompt-set pass and 24h soft-traffic gating before 20% rollout
Risk: cost spikes from aggressive model trials - Mitigation: set per-endpoint daily token budget and circuit breaker alerts
Risk: misalignment between PM priorities and Eng capacity - Mitigation: weekly triage sync and explicit capacity commitments for top 6 endpoints
